title: Knowledge Gateway MCP — knowledge_status Response
description: Phase 0 contract-only. docs/plans/knowledge-gateway-mcp-proposal.md §9.2 is a prose bullet list, not a JSON example — the property names below are this contract's own best-effort mapping of each prose bullet to a JSON property name, not a proposal-verbatim quotation. reported_schema_version is deliberately named differently from this file's own top-level schema_version key: schema_version versions this schema file itself, reported_schema_version is the schema version a running gateway instance reports at call time — mirroring the retrieval_event_schema_version vs. retrieval_version distinction at tools/retrieval_events.py:44-46. additionalProperties:false is the direct enforcement of §9.2's 'should not expose provider weights, semantic thresholds, internal cache-level controls, or provider-selection switches' rule.
